blocks.title: Connect Neo 1 with other Connector
blocks.subtitle: Give any AI assistant direct access to your NeoSapien memories.

items.caption: Sign in with the NeoSapien account
items.detail: (This can be different from your ChatGPT account)

items.caption: Congrats 🎉 NeoSapien MCP is now connected

blocks.title: If NeoSapien MCP doesn't work or appear in the chat, do one of these:
bullets: Close the tab and reopen ChatGPT
Re-authenticate with the existing NeoSapien account
Remove the NeoSapien from connectors and add it again.

blocks.title: Here's what it does for you
blocks.subtitle: You ask, Neo 1 recalls, your AI does the work. Things you can do:

blocks.title: Draft your replies
blocks.subtitle: “Write the follow up email on what I owe Subodh”

blocks.title: Prep for what's next
blocks.subtitle: “Prep me for my meeting with Mohit, what did he ask last time?”

blocks.title: Recall any detail
blocks.subtitle: “What's the medicine I discussed for my father?”

blocks.title: Turn talk into to-dos
blocks.subtitle: “Make a task list from my last daily standup”

blocks.title: Work across your tools
blocks.subtitle: “Add those tasks to my Notion.” Your AI has both Neo 1 and your other apps.

blocks.title: Export data
blocks.subtitle: “Export all memories from yesterday as a CSV”
